headline: The multi-provider AI topic engine — a Winslow-style crew that turns one line into a living, self-running app.
note: Winslow orchestration status board. Winslow edits the box data file (ROADMAP_DATA_PATH) and this updates with no redeploy. Reconciled against GitHub main (ChooseYourTopic/CYTAPI + CYTWeb). This is the internal build board — the customer-facing product roadmap lives at /roadmap.

live.title: Multi-provider AI topic engine — cascade model ladder
live.detail: OpenAI + Grok/xAI + Gemini (all OpenAI-compatible), per-(user,provider) key + priority, cascade-on-exhaustion. Gemini gemini-3.x-flash is live + free at the top of the ladder.

live.title: One line → a living app, run by an agent swarm
live.detail: A topic + intent spins up a Winslow-style crew (9 specialists + orchestrator) that researches, builds, markets and runs it, surfaced in living dashboards.

live.title: Empire Integration Bridge — PROVIDER surface
live.detail: GET /api/v1/bridge/{ping,capabilities,records/*} behind auth.bridge (owner-minted cyt_qb_ key). topic + customer resources + 4 Winslow-orchestration RecordProviders (roadmap · next-steps · context · activity). Connected & live into QuickerBiz.

live.title: #1 — 2FA step-up on API-key reveal / issue
live.detail: Revealing or minting a plaintext cyt_qb_ bridge key requires a TOTP step-up (enroll first if needed). The generic step-up modal pattern reused Empire-wide.

live.title: #2 — Unified connectivity hub (multi-key + AI-provider keys)
live.detail: Settings becomes the home for ALL connectivity: outbound bridge/partner keys per consuming app + AI-model provider keys (Claude · Grok · Gemini · OpenAI) with priority + default-model selection. Surfaces the existing model ladder rather than duplicating it.

live.title: #4 — Per-key platform association from the integrations directory
live.detail: Every issued key/token is tagged to a target platform picked from the integrations directory (7 Empire products + external QuickBooks/Zoho-style placeholders). Applies to bridge keys AND AI-provider tokens.

live.title: #5 — Fine-grained module RBAC (C1+C2+C3, complete)
live.detail: Entitlement = role (admin>support>licensee>collaborator) + topic/license binding + per-module grant, fail-closed. C1 topic_collaborators + roleFor/hasModuleGrant; C2 licensee grant/revoke UI (2FA-gated); C3 enforcement gate + license-ACL managed by owner+admin.

live.title: #3 C1 — API-key generation history
live.detail: Per-key issued-by user · date · name · scope (additive audit column, backfilled) + a history list including revoked/expired keys. GET /me/bridge-keys/history + CYTWeb issuance-history panel.

live.title: #3 C2 — API-key usage tracking (last-used + use-count)
live.detail: auth.bridge resolve() bumps use_count + last_used_at in one atomic keyed UPDATE on each authenticated bridge call; failed/revoked/expired keys never count. CYTWeb shows 'Last used <when> · N uses'.

live.title: ops-MCP — run the agents on your own Claude subscription
live.detail: Local connector + hosted opsmcp at /ops-mcp/. Two billing paths: subscription ($0, Claude Code session) vs metered API key.

inProgress.title: Live /preview/status board + /preview/releases build log
inProgress.detail: This board + a companion build-milestone log, reading roadmap.json / preview-releases.json at request time via ROADMAP_DATA_PATH / RELEASES_DATA_PATH so Winslow updates them with no redeploy. Coexists with the product /preview, /roadmap and /releases pages.

waiting.title: #3 C3 — per-use API-key activity log
waiting.detail: A per-key activity log (each use: timestamp · resource · source/IP) with a settings drill-in. The next #3 chunk after C1+C2 shipped.
waiting.waitsOn: Dispatch when CYT frees — gap-check first

waiting.title: CYTWeb collaborator topic-navigation
waiting.detail: Surface collaborated (non-owned) topics in the picker + hide ungranted module tabs by consuming the grant-filtered topic-show sections. Deferred from #5 C3 (needs collaborator nav plumbing; the API gate is already source of truth and the UI fails safe on 403).

waiting.title: Widen license-ACL authority to support role
waiting.detail: License ACL is currently managed by owner + admin only. Optionally extend to the support role if Tracy wants.
waiting.waitsOn: Tracy: decision on support-role ACL authority

queue.title: #2 — Unified connectivity hub + multi-key + AI-provider keys
#4 — Per-key platform association from integrations directory
#5 C2 — Per-module grant model + licensee grant/revoke UI (2FA)
#5 C3 — Module enforcement gate + license ACL (owner+admin)

enhancements.title: #3 C3 — per-use activity log (open chunk)
enhancements.detail: The remaining #3 chunk: per-call timestamp / resource / source-IP drill-in in the settings API-Keys area. Gap-check before dispatch.

enhancements.title: Support-role license-ACL authority
enhancements.detail: Currently owner + admin manage a license (topic) ACL. Decide whether the support role should also manage collaborator grants.

enhancements.title: Collaborator topic-navigation UX
enhancements.detail: Give collaborators a nav surface for non-owned topics and hide ungranted module tabs (API gate already fail-closed). Deferred as a feature, not a minimal alignment.

enhancements.title: Cross-cutting: extend key hubs to more Empire apps
enhancements.detail: The 2FA-gated connectivity hub + per-key audit/usage/activity pattern is cross-cutting — QuickerBiz + other Empire apps get the same hub.
